name: Magnitude Head Numerative

dimensions.meaning: Denotes base magnitude value (powers of ten > 10)
dimensions.function: Head of magnitude phrase; licenses factor modifier
dimensions.distribution: Requires factor in most contexts; heads DP

1.definition: Denotes a base magnitude (hundred, thousand, million, etc.) that can scale a quantity

examples.note: Magnitude determinative head; factor two is its modifier
Magnitude head inside an additive coordination

projection.target: Hundred remains singular in exact two hundred books and supplies its scale. In hundreds of books, the same base has count plural morphology and an oblique dependent. These diagnostics separate the head’s lexical uses.
projection.evidence: Reynolds identifies a determinative magnitude head in the exact phrases and distinguishes plural magnitude nouns in the categorial analysis.

curious.title: Hundred, thousand and million as base amounts
curious.summary: Hundred, thousand and million are base amounts that other numbers can scale.
curious.body: Words like hundred, thousand and million stand for a base amount. In two hundred, the two scales that base: it says how many hundreds. This dictionary says such a word needs a number in front of it in most contexts. The same base can also be a plural noun. Hundred stays singular in two hundred books, but hundreds of books has a plural ending and an of phrase. The dictionary treats these as different uses of the same word. A base can also sit inside a longer number, as in twelve thousand and forty-one.

examples.text: two hundred books and [hundreds] of books

curious.try: Compare two hundred books with hundreds of books. Which one has a plural ending, and which one has an of?

teacher.summary: Shows how hundred, thousand and million work as the head of a number phrase, and how that differs from their plural noun uses.
teacher.explain: A magnitude head is a determinative such as hundred, thousand or million, denoting a base value that can scale a quantity. It's the head of the magnitude phrase and licenses a factor modifier (two hundred). This dictionary says it requires a factor in most contexts. Hundred stays singular in exact two hundred books and supplies its scale. In hundreds of books, the same base is a plural count noun with an of dependent, which is a separate lexical use. The head can also appear inside an additive coordination (twelve thousand and forty-one). This dictionary marks the analysis as provisional.
teacher.terms: Numeral is the traditional word for number words in general. This dictionary calls hundred, thousand and million magnitude determinatives when they head a number phrase.

contrasts.note: Exact quantity, singular magnitude head with a factor.
Plural count noun with an of dependent.

watch_for: A learner might add a plural ending to hundred in two hundred books, as in hundreds of books, when the two uses differ.
A learner might treat hundreds of books as the same construction as two hundred books.
teacher.activity: Students sort phrases such as two hundred books, hundreds of books and twelve thousand into exact quantities and plural noun uses, then say which has a factor in front.
